title: Settle in
target: Three flexible easy-run slots; use conversational effort (about 3–4/10), with walking breaks whenever needed.
adjustment: Includes the completed 3 km on 22 Oct; the other sessions remain planned.

title: Build consistency
target: Three flexible easy-run slots; use conversational effort (about 3–4/10), with walking breaks whenever needed.
adjustment: Progress only if week 1 felt comfortable and recovery is normal.

title: Extend gently
target: Three flexible easy-run slots; use conversational effort (about 3–4/10), with walking breaks whenever needed.
adjustment: Repeat the previous week if the longer run or football left lingering fatigue.

title: Recovery week
target: Three flexible easy-run slots; use conversational effort (about 3–4/10), with walking breaks whenever needed.
adjustment: A lighter week. Do not catch up on missed kilometres.

title: Check endurance
target: Three flexible easy-run slots; use conversational effort (about 3–4/10), with walking breaks whenever needed.
adjustment: Choose 7 km first; 8 km is optional only if recovered. Reassess the race goal.

title: Longest training outing
target: Three flexible easy-run slots; use conversational effort (about 3–4/10), with walking breaks whenever needed.
adjustment: Use the lower end first. This does not establish readiness for 21.1 km.

title: Ease down
target: Three flexible easy-run slots; use conversational effort (about 3–4/10), with walking breaks whenever needed.
adjustment: Keep every session comfortable; prioritize recovery over extra distance.

title: Race window
target: Optional short easy run, rest, then race day if ready.
adjustment: Optional 2 km easy on 10 or 11 Dec; rest on 12 Dec. Race 13 Dec only if ready; pace and participation remain reassessable.
